prompt: Explain why streamlining a high-speed vehicle reduces the drag force acting on it at a given speed.

mark_scheme.criterion: Allows air to flow smoothly along the vehicle contours / delays flow separation.
Reduces the size of the turbulent wake / low-pressure region behind the vehicle.
Reduces the pressure difference between the front and rear of the vehicle (reduces form/pressure drag).

hints: Think about what happens to the airflow lines as they pass over a blunt vs a streamlined shape.
Mention turbulence, the wake behind the vehicle, and the pressure difference.
solution: Streamlining allows air to flow smoothly along the body contours, delaying flow separation. This reduces the size of the turbulent low-pressure wake behind the vehicle, thereby reducing the pressure difference between front and rear (form drag).
teacher_walkthrough: Point 1: Smooth airflow / delayed boundary layer separation (B1).
Point 2: Smaller turbulent wake behind the body (B1).
Point 3: Reduced pressure difference between front and back / reduced form drag (B1).
Award up to 3 marks for these three linked scientific ideas.
